tasks.title: Replace memory-based compaction watch with transcript-based evaluation
tasks.notes: compactionWatch deleted; stateless needsReprime evaluates one desc ListMessagesPage (newest completed compaction strictly newer than newest user message, ties = continued, fail-open on read errors); compacts field/wiring, markPending, and snapshot observation block removed; maybeReprime gains r.Context(). go vet ./... clean, go test ./... all packages ok, lessmess validate: violations []

tasks.title: Cover the re-prime rule with regression tests and verify the suite
tasks.notes: reprime_test.go rewritten around the stateless rule: 9 tests cover stale compaction after restart (no wrap), failed compaction (no wrap), in-flight race (raw -> wrapped once -> raw), tie timestamps (no wrap), empty/unreadable transcript (fail-open), unbound session and unreadable ledger (fail-open), queued + observed compaction (wrapped once then raw), and the /deliver path wrapping identically. go vet ./... clean; go test ./... all packages ok; lessmess validate: no violations (only pre-existing docs-queue warnings).
